Smart Agri Lid

The Smart Agri Lid is a sensor-based monitoring system designed to monitor the conditions of fresh fruits during transportation in agricultural crates. The system continuously measures temperature, humidity, and motion/impact conditions inside and around the crate to identify conditions that may affect the quality of the produce.

The system monitors sudden jerks or impacts during transportation using a motion sensor. Whenever a significant jerk is detected, the event is recorded and the jerk count is displayed on the onboard display, allowing the user to track rough handling during transportation.

The system also continuously monitors temperature and humidity against predefined threshold values. If the temperature exceeds the specified threshold, an alert is displayed on the screen, along with a red LED and buzzer indication to notify the user of potentially unfavorable conditions.

When the humidity exceeds its predefined threshold, the system automatically activates a humidifier mechanism to help maintain the desired environmental conditions for the produce.

Inshort, Smart Agri Lid provides real-time monitoring, visual and audible alerts, impact tracking, and automatic humidity control, helping maintain suitable conditions for fresh fruits during farm-to-market transportation.
